title: Preserve ordinary terminal transitions during graceful shutdown without permitting retired-state writes
outcome: Define and test terminal-transition handling between graceful shutdown signal and final persistence drain, preserving shutdown/restore write fencing and truthful Stop/result/exit state.
acceptance: An ordinary mediated result or runtime exit arriving during the graceful-shutdown window has a documented, tested durable outcome rather than a silent successful no-op.
A Stop during that window reports what was stopped and persisted, and no old observation worker or terminal writer can overwrite a successor restored AppState row.
The maintained full gate passes on the exact input.
